fields.label: Shop Name
fields.description: Unique name of this shop connection, e.g. 'Main Shop'. It is stored on every imported invoice and customer.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Only enabled shops are imported and synchronised by the scheduler. Keep it off until the connection test succeeds.

fields.label: Base URL
fields.description: Shop address without /api/v1, e.g. https://shop.example.com. Must start with https:// (http:// only for localhost).

fields.label: API Username
fields.description: Shop user allowed to use the REST API, e.g. api@example.com. Use a dedicated user with minimal rights.

fields.label: API Password
fields.description: Password of the API user. It is stored encrypted and sent to the shop over HTTPS.

fields.label: Import From
fields.description: Orders purchased before this date and time are never imported, e.g. your go-live date 2027-01-01 00:00. The first import starts here.

fields.label: Last Import
fields.description: Set by the importer after each run. Not editable.

fields.label: Retry Window (Days)
fields.description: Each import fetches the orders of this many days before the last import again, so orders that failed or were not yet in an import status are retried.

fields.label: Company
fields.description: Company that owns the invoices, e.g. 'My Company GmbH'. The tax template and shipping item must belong to it.

fields.label: Warehouse
fields.description: Warehouse that stock is taken from for shop orders and whose stock levels are sent to the shop, e.g. 'Stores'.

fields.label: Customer Group
fields.description: Customer group for new customers created from shop orders, e.g. 'Individual' (German: Einzelperson). Must not be a group.

fields.label: Territory
fields.description: Territory for new customers created from shop orders, e.g. 'Germany' (German: Deutschland). Must not be a group.

fields.label: Invoice Naming Series
fields.description: Naming series for imported invoices, e.g. ACC-SINV-.YYYY.-. Leave empty to use the default series of Sales Invoice.

fields.label: Item Match Shop Field
fields.description: Shop product field that identifies the item: products_model (the shop's model/article number) or products_ean. Example: products_model.

fields.label: Item Match ERP Field
fields.description: ERPNext field compared with the shop value: Item Code or Barcode. Example: Item Code with products_model, Barcode with products_ean. An order line without a match is reported as an error.

fields.label: Shipping Item
fields.description: Non-stock service item used for the shipping charge line of each invoice, e.g. 'Shipping' (German: Versand).

fields.label: Sales Taxes Template
fields.description: Sales Taxes and Charges Template applied to imported invoices, e.g. the template for 19 % VAT. Shop prices are gross, so its taxes are treated as included in the price.

fields.label: Tax Map
fields.description: Maps the tax rate of each order line to an Item Tax Template, e.g. 19 → 'VAT 19 %' and 7 → 'VAT 7 %'. A rate without a row is reported as an error.

fields.label: Payment Map
fields.description: Maps the shop payment method of an order to an ERPNext Mode of Payment. Optional: payment methods without a row are imported without a payment.

fields.label: Import Status IDs
fields.description: Comma-separated shop order status IDs that are ready for import, e.g. 1,2. Orders in other statuses wait and are retried within the retry window; the shop's status list shows the IDs.

fields.label: Cancelled Status ID
fields.description: Shop status ID of cancelled orders, e.g. 4. Such orders are never imported; if an imported order is cancelled later, an error is logged so you can cancel the invoice by hand.

fields.label: Shipped Status ID
fields.description: Shop status ID set on the order when a tracking number is sent, e.g. 3 (shipped). The customer is notified by the shop.

fields.label: DHL Carrier ID
fields.description: ID of the DHL carrier in the shop, e.g. 1. It is sent with the tracking number so the shop shows the right tracking link.

fields.label: Submit Invoices
fields.description: If checked, imported invoices are submitted automatically (and paid if the payment method is 'Paid at Checkout'); otherwise they stay as drafts to review. Example: off while testing.

fields.label: Sync Stock
fields.description: If checked, the sellable quantity of stock items (actual minus reserved) in the warehouse is sent to the shop after stock changes and in a full sync. Example: on after go-live.
